description: Image Description: The image shows a beach scene under an overcast sky. In the foreground, there are two orange peels resting on the sand, slightly out of focus. The background features the ocean with gentle waves approaching the shore. The horizon is visible where the sea meets the cloudy sky, creating a serene and muted atmosphere. The overall color palette is subdued, with the bright orange of the peels contrasting against the grays and browns of the sand and sky.
